description: Unified Aphrody plugin: AI/LLM, Dragon Ball/Shenron, OS kernel, Aphrody Web, N2B and WinClean.

interface.shortDescription: One plugin for Aphrody AI, Dragon Ball/Shenron, system and web tools.
interface.longDescription: Unified Aphrody plugin for local AI and LLM workflows, Dragon Ball/Shenron research, the Aphrody kernel, WinClean, web and N2B capabilities. It bundles the skills and agents for these surfaces and connects to the unified local aphrody-kernel MCP server. Secrets remain in the host environment.
